messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated release wave for the next cut. Intend to bump API -> 1.12.0, runtime -> 0.51.0, console -> 2.3.0, and SDKs -> 0.9.0. Target cutoff tomorrow 11:00 PT. Any conflicts with that window?

sam: fine from SDK side. I'll open PRs for console and js-sdk now, should be ready in ~2h.

leo: runtime has a small breaking rename in the KV cache layer. We can ship a backward shim but recommend a staggered rollout: runtime canary at +30m, full roll at +90m after metrics look clean.

maya: staggered approach makes sense. We'll keep the API/console/sdk bumps at the main cutoff and hold runtime until canary passes. Sam, pls add changelog lines for console + sdk; I'll take API notes.

jing: @sam please include the migration snippet for the console toggle and the feature-flag key in the changelog :+1:. Also call out any config changes for on-prem.

sam: will do. PRs up: https://git.redwood/repo/console/pull/482 and https://git.redwood/repo/js-sdk/pull/987 — reviewers requested (jing, maya).

pradeep: infra check: any LB or routing changes needed? If runtime goes staggered we should ensure routing policy supports fallback to 0.50.x variants.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-runtime-1789999999 at 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z

pradeep: verified — LB change is already staged and supports weighted routing. No maintenance window required. Will watch during canary.

leo: runtime PR note + bump command for whoever lands it:
```
# create release branch and bump runtime
git checkout -b release/runtime-0.51.0
sed -i 's/0.50.2/0.51.0/g' build/versions.toml
git commit -am "bump runtime to 0.51.0"
```

maya: concise action list for clarity:
1) sam: add changelog lines and migration notes, link PRs.
2) maya: add API release notes and compat table.
3) leo: run runtime canary, share p50/p95/errors after 15m.
4) pradeep: monitor LB/routing and be ready to rollback traffic.
5) jing: validate console feature-flag and on-prem config.

sam: FYI — changelog entries added to console PR, SDK PR includes migration instructions for auth changes.

leo: canary update (15m): p50 18ms, p95 120ms, no increase in 5xx. Will hold for +45m then roll if steady.

maya: thanks — no objections from my side. I'll start the release checklist and tag a release manager.

sam: pinging @eng-releases for a quick thumbs when you see this :shipit:

alex: :thumbsup: from client SDKs team, go ahead on the main cutoff.

maya: great — closing plan here. If anyone finds issues, post in this thread and we'll pause the rollout. Thanks all!
